verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official Caveman SDK in any language. The available hooks are adjacent rather than the capability itself: a base-URL swap (pointing existing apps or other vendors' clients at Caveman's proxy), a published OpenAPI spec (a building block for generating clients), and an open-source CLI that wraps other agents. Official SDKs are a fair question for a platform like this, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
